name: Water Factory 21 wastewater recharge
description: Treated municipal wastewater was reused in a groundwater injection barrier against seawater intrusion.

date.label: October 1976
date.basis: The date applies to this documented case, not to the worldwide origin of the capability.

events.statement: EPA reports the Water Factory 21 injection period began in October 1976 and that reverse osmosis was added later.

evidence.supports: EPA reports the Water Factory 21 injection period began in October 1976 and that reverse osmosis was added later.
The district dates the facility’s unveiling to 1975; EPA’s operating table places the start of injection in October 1976.
EPA reports the Water Factory 21 injection period began in October 1976 and that reverse osmosis was added later.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest researched operational or depicted case for this record, not a claim of global priority.

caveats: EPA describes injection beginning in October 1976; the operator’s retrospective describes a 1975 opening and gives a different account of early chronology. Design capacity is not actual output.

research.note: Independent review checked the EPA operating-period table and 15-million-gallon design flow; the district account differs on opening and reverse-osmosis timing.

measures.subject: Water Factory 21
measures.conditions: Design flow reported by EPA; the same report says the plant did not operate at that design flow throughout its history.

evidence.locator: Introduction and design versus achieved flow
evidence.supports: EPA reports 15 million gallons per day design capacity and distinguishes it from achieved flow.
